Warrior changes in WoW Forever

Arms adds Spearing Strike, Bloodthrill and Weaponmaster, which takes in the four weapon specializations. Fury adds Reckless Swings, Improved Whirlwind, Lingering Rage, Furious Precision and Gore Drinker, Whirlwind strikes with both weapons, and Tactical Mastery is now trained at level 14. Every Warrior talent and spell change in World of Warcraft: Forever, compared with Classic, with its source.

Rogue changes in WoW Forever

Assassination adds Mutilate and Venom. Combat folds the dagger, fist and mace specializations into Hack and Slash and adds Flawless Execution and Puncturing Wounds, and Poisons and Lockpicking become secondary skills, like First Aid. Every Rogue talent and spell change in World of Warcraft: Forever, compared with Classic, with its source.

Priest changes in WoW Forever

Discipline adds Penance, Holy adds Holy Binding and Prayer of Mending, and Binding Heal, Divine Spirit and Lightwell are now trained. Fear Ward and Devouring Plague are no longer tied to one race. Every Priest talent and spell change in World of Warcraft: Forever, compared with Classic, with its source.

Classic → Forever
All changes: Priest
Power in Light
Your Smite and Penance spells deal 2% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire or Shadow Word: Pain.
New
›
Wand Specialization
2 ranks (Classic: 5). Moved from column 3 to column 2. Rank 2: 25% instead of 10%.
Changed
›
Twin Disciplines
Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 1%.
New
›
Silent Resolve
3 ranks (Classic: 5). Effect rewritten.
Changed
›
Holy Precision
Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 6%.
New
›
Mental Strength
Moved from tier 5 to tier 2. Effect rewritten.
Changed
›
Martyrdom
Focused Casting's Interrupt resistance changes from 10% to 20% at rank 1; trigger chance and duration remain.
Changed
›
Mental Agility
3 ranks (Classic: 5). Moved from tier 4 to tier 3. Rank 3: 10% instead of 6%, reworded.
Changed
›
Inner Focus
Same numbers, reworded.
Changed
›
Improved Power Word: Shield
Power Word: Shield's absorption bonus changes from 5% to 7% at rank 1.
Changed
›
Meditation
Moved from column 3 to column 4. Rank 3: 50% instead of 15%.
Changed
›
Improved Inner Fire
Also adds Inner Fire charges; rank-1 Armor bonus changes from 10% to 15%.
Changed
›
Improved Mana Burn
Mana Burn cast-time reduction changes from 0.25 to 0.5 sec at rank 1.
Changed
›
Soul Warding
Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.
New
›
Penance
Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 45 Holy damage to an enemy, or 134 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.
New
›
Renewed Hope
Listed direct heals gain crit chance on Weakened Soul targets and shorten Weakened Soul's remaining duration.
New
›
Divine Aegis
Your non-periodic critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 5% of the amount healed. Shields up to 1200 damage and lasts 12 sec.
New
›
Power Infusion
Requires Penance (Classic: Mental Strength). Same numbers, reworded.
Changed
›
Twilight Focus
Replaces Healing Focus. 3 ranks (Classic: 2).
Changed
›
Holy Nova
26 to 30 instead of 29 to 34, 50 to 57 instead of 54 to 63.
Changed
›
Blessed Recovery
Also triggers from a hit exceeding 30% maximum health; refreshing the effect preserves remaining healing.
Changed
›
Inspiration
Armor buff now triggers from all non-periodic critical heals rather than four named spells.
Changed
›
Improved Healing
Mana-cost reduction now also covers Penance and Prayer of Mending.
Changed
›
Searing Light
Replaces Smite/Holy Fire's bonus with a smaller bonus to all Holy damage; Holy Fire ticks can also make the next Holy Nova free.
Changed
›
Holy Binding
Each time you heal a target other than yourself with Flash Heal, you are healed for 50% as much. This healing generates no threat.
New
›
Litany of Light
Alternating healing spells refunds part of the new heal's base Mana cost.
New
›
Spirit of Redemption
Spirit of Redemption duration changes from 10 to 15 sec.
Changed
›
Spiritual Guidance
Spirit-based healing bonus remains 5% at rank 1; spell-damage conversion changes from 5% to 1%.
Changed
›
Spiritual Healing
3 ranks (Classic: 5). Rank 3: 10% instead of 6%, reworded.
Changed
›
Prayer of Mending
Places a spell on the target that heals them for 172 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing.
New
›
Shadow Focus
Moved from tier 2 to tier 1. Effect rewritten.
Changed
›
Blackout
Moved from column 3 to column 2.
Moved
›
Spirit Tap
Moved from column 2 to column 3. Effect rewritten.
Changed
›
Improved Mind Blast
Moved from tier 3 to tier 2.
Moved
›
Improved Shadow Word: Pain
Moved from column 2 to column 3.
Moved
›
Shadow Reach
2 ranks (Classic: 3). Moved from tier 4 to tier 2. Rank 2: 20% instead of 13%, reworded.
Changed
›
Improved Psychic Scream
Moved from column 1 to column 2. Requires Blackout.
Changed
›
Mind Flay
63 instead of 75.
Changed
›
Improved Mind Flay
Each instance of damage of Mind Flay deals 10% more damage than its previous instance of damage.
New
›
Dark Inspiration
Your Mind Blast and fully channeled Mind Flay causes Dark Inspiration, increasing yours and your party's Spirit by 3% for 10 sec.
New
›
Vampiric Embrace
Moved from tier 5 to tier 4. Numbers and wording changed.
Changed
›
Shadow Weaving
3 ranks (Classic: 5). Moved from column 4 to column 3. Effect rewritten.
Changed
›
Silence
No longer requires Improved Psychic Scream. Numbers and wording changed.
Changed
›
Devouring Contagion
Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 25%.
New
›
Early Demise
Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 15%.
New
›
Darkness
Same described 2% rank-1 bonus; wording changes from Shadow spell damage to Shadow damage.
Changed
›
Shadowform
Adds cheaper Shadow spells and stronger Shadow crits; damage bonus is 10% vs 15%. The casting restriction now says healing spells, not Holy spells.
Changed
›
Unbreakable Will
Not in the Discipline tree any more.
Removed
›
Improved Power Word: Fortitude
Not in the Discipline tree any more.
Removed
›
Divine Spirit
No longer a talent: trained from level 30.
Removed
›
Improved Prayer of Healing
Not in the Holy tree any more.
Removed
›
Shadow Affinity
Not in the Shadow Magic tree any more.
Removed
›
Improved Fade
Not in the Shadow Magic tree any more.
Removed
›
Force of Will
Not in the Discipline tree any more.
Removed
›
Lightwell
No longer a talent: trained from level 40.
Removed
›
Improved Vampiric Embrace
Not in the Shadow Magic tree any more.
Removed
›
Confounding Flash
Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage taken will break the effect.
New
›
Divine Grace
Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 1285 to 1513 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.
New
›
Contingency Plan
Place a Holy ward on an ally for 30 sec.
New
›
Dark Sacrifice
Cannibalize 1600 of your own Health over 15 sec to gain 1920 Mana.
New
›
Chastise
Chastise the target, causing 272 to 306 Holy damage and Immobilizing them for up to 2 sec. Only works against Humanoids. This spell causes very low threat.
New
›
Shadow Word: Death
A word of dark binding that inflicts 444 to 472 Shadow damage to the target. Season of Discovery had a spell by this name
New
›
Divine Spirit
A Discipline talent in Classic; trained without one now. Rank 4: 1 hr instead of 30 min.
Was a talent

Lightwell
A Holy talent in Classic; trained without one now.
Was a talent

Desperate Prayer
No longer for Human. Rank 7: 1285 to 1513 instead of 1340 to 1579.
Other races

Devouring Plague
Dwarf, Human, Night Elf and Troll can learn it too (Classic: Undead only). Rank 6: Cooldown 24 sec instead of 3 min; 848 instead of 904.
Other races
›
Fear Ward
Human, Night Elf, Troll and Undead can learn it too (Classic: Dwarf only). Cooldown 3 min instead of 30 sec; 3 min instead of 10 min; Usable in Shadowform too.
Other races

Rank 6: 70 instead of 54, 1 hr instead of 30 min.
Changed

Rank 3: 157 to 181 instead of 143 to 165; Spell power bonus 71.4% instead of 44.6%.
Changed

Rank 6: 204 instead of 20, reworded.

Rank 9: 477 to 503 instead of 508 to 537.

Rank 6: 56 instead of 64, 204 instead of 20, reworded.

Resurrection
Rank 5: Usable in Shadowform too.
Changed

Cure Disease
Usable in Shadowform too.
Changed
›
Elune's Grace
Ranks 2 to 5 gone (Classic goes to rank 5). Costs 3% of base mana instead of 60 Mana; Tooltip rewritten.
Changed
›
Heal
Rank 4: 634 to 713 instead of 734 to 827.
Changed

Feedback
Rank 5: Costs 230 Mana instead of 580 Mana.

Mana Burn
Ranks 1, 4, 5 differ from Classic. Rank 5: 746 to 788 instead of 746 to 789.

Flash Heal
Rank 7: 774 to 910 instead of 828 to 975.

Shadowguard
Rank 6: 96 instead of 116.

Holy Fire
Rank 8: 184 to 232 instead of 355 to 449, 75 instead of 145; Usable in Shadowform too.

Levitate

Rank 5: Range 40 yd instead of none; Tooltip rewritten.

Warlock changes in WoW Forever

Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 4% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 4% for 20 sec.

Deals 100 to 114 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

Paladin changes in WoW Forever

Consecration and Blessing of Kings are now trained by every Paladin, and Blessing of Sanctuary is gone. Holy adds Light’s Vigil and Infusion of Light, Protection builds on the new Seal of Fury, and Holy Strike is a new trained spell. Every Paladin talent and spell change in World of Warcraft: Forever, compared with Classic, with its source.

Druid changes in WoW Forever

Omen of Clarity and Nature’s Grasp are now trained instead of taken as Balance talents, and every Druid learns Revive. Balance adds Eclipse, Feral adds Primal Bite, Lacerate and Predatory Discipline, and Restoration adds Wild Growth and Bloom. Every Druid talent and spell change in World of Warcraft: Forever, compared with Classic, with its source.

New

Shaman changes in WoW Forever

Enhancement adds Maelstrom Weapon, and Restoration adds Water Shield and Riptide. Fire Nova Totem becomes Fire Nova, which strikes from your active Fire totem. Every Shaman talent and spell change in World of Warcraft: Forever, compared with Classic, with its source.

All changes: Shaman
Concussion
Damage bonus now specifies Earth Shock instead of all Shock spells.
Changed
›
Elemental Devastation
Moved from tier 4 to tier 2. Same numbers, reworded.
Changed
›
Reverberation
Moved from tier 3 to tier 2. Same numbers, reworded.
Changed
›
Elemental Alacrity
Renamed from Lightning Mastery. 3 ranks (Classic: 5). Moved from tier 6 to tier 2. No longer requires Call of Thunder. Rank 3: 0.50 sec instead of 0.6 sec.
Changed
›
Call of Flame
Moved from column 3 to column 4. Effect rewritten.
Changed
›
Elemental Warding
Moved from tier 2 to tier 3. 3% instead of 4%.
Changed
›
Trial by Fire
Replaces Improved Fire Totems.
Changed
›
Eye of the Storm
Effect rewritten.
Changed
›
Earthbound
Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast.
New
›
Elemental Reach
Renamed from Storm Reach. Same numbers, reworded.
Changed
›
Call of Thunder
1 rank (Classic: 5). Moved from tier 3 to tier 5. 5% instead of 1%, reworded.
Changed
›
Lightning Overload
Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 10% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.
New
›
Elemental Fury
5 ranks (Classic: 1). Moved from tier 5 to tier 6. Requires Lightning Overload. 20% instead of 100%, reworded.
Changed
›
Lightning Mastery
Replaces Elemental Mastery. Requires Call of Thunder (Classic: Elemental Fury).
Changed
›
Earth's Grasp
Moved from Elemental Combat to Enhancement.
Moved
›
Thundering Strikes
Moved from tier 2 to tier 1. Same numbers, reworded.
Changed
›
Ancestral Knowledge
Moved from column 2 to column 3. Effect rewritten.
Changed
›
Mental Dexterity
Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 33% of your Intellect.
New
›
Improved Lightning Shield
Moved from column 4 to column 3.
Moved
›
Elemental Weapons
Moved from tier 5 to tier 3. Rank 2: 13% instead of 14%.
Changed
›
Shamanistic Focus
Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.
New
›
Anticipation
3 ranks (Classic: 5). Rank 3: 6% instead of 3%.
Changed
›
Toughness
Moved from column 3 to column 1. Effect rewritten.
Changed
›
Flurry
Requires Mental Dexterity (Classic: Thundering Strikes). Same numbers, reworded.
Changed
›
Stormstrike
Moved from tier 7 to tier 4. No longer requires Elemental Weapons. Effect rewritten.
Changed
›
Improved Ghost Wolf
Moves to row 4 (was row 2). Ghost Wolf can now be used indoors, and rank 2 cuts its cast time by 3 sec instead of 2.
Changed
›
Spirit Weapons
Replaces Parry. Moved from column 3 to column 1.
Changed
›
Mental Quickness
Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 15% of your Intellect.
New
›
Improved Stormstrike
Stormstrike can grant Mana regeneration while casting; Dodges and Parries can reset its cooldown.
New
›
Maelstrom Weapon
When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance (based on weapon speed) to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%.
New
›
Rage of the Farseer
Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.
New
›
Tidal Focus
Numbers and wording changed.
Changed
›
Mindfulness
Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
New
›
Natural Grace
Renamed from Healing Grace. Moved from tier 3 to tier 2. Same numbers, reworded.
Changed
›
Totemic Focus
Same numbers, reworded.
Changed
›
Improved Reincarnation
Moved from column 1 to column 4. Numbers and wording changed.
Changed
›
Ancestral Healing
Moved from tier 2 to tier 3. Rank 2: 17% instead of 16%.
Changed
›
Healing Focus
3 ranks (Classic: 5). Effect rewritten.
Changed
›
Water Shield
Three water globes restore Mana when you are hit or critically heal; activations are rate-limited. Only one Elemental Shield may be active.
New
›
Tidal Mastery
Moved from column 3 to column 1. Same numbers, reworded.
Changed
›
Restorative Totems
Numbers and wording changed.
Changed
›
Mana Tide Totem
Moved from tier 7 to tier 4. No longer requires Restorative Totems. 88 instead of 170, 30 yards instead of 20 yards.
Changed
›
Healing Way
Moved from column 1 to column 2. Effect rewritten.
Changed
›
Riptide
Heals a friendly target for 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.
New
›
Totemic Mastery
Not in the Restoration tree any more.
Removed
›
Nature's Guidance
Not in the Restoration tree any more.
Removed
›
Enhancing Totems
Not in the Enhancement tree any more.
Removed
›
Shield Specialization
Not in the Enhancement tree any more.
Removed
›
Two-Handed Axes and Maces
Not in the Enhancement tree any more.
Removed
›
Weapon Mastery
Not in the Enhancement tree any more.
Removed
›
Improved Weapon Totems
Not in the Enhancement tree any more.
Removed
›
Totemic Call
Relocates your active totems to your location.
New
›
Call of the Elements
Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.
New
›
Totemic Recall
Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.
New
›
Call of the Ancestors
Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements.
New
›
Call of the Spirits
Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements or Call of the Ancestors.
New
›
Fire Nova
Called Fire Nova Totem in Classic. Rank 5: Costs 375 Mana instead of 520 Mana; Cooldown 10 sec instead of 15 sec; Range 30 yd instead of none.
Renamed
›
Lightning Bolt
Rank 10: Costs 220 Mana instead of 265 Mana; Cast time 2.5 sec instead of 3 sec; 342 to 381 instead of 428 to 477.
Changed
›
Rockbiter Weapon
Rank 7: 60 minutes instead of 5 minutes.
Changed
›
Healing Wave
Rank 10: 1508 to 1722 instead of 1620 to 1850.
Changed
›
Earth Shock
Ranks 1 to 6 differ from Classic. Rank 6: 380 to 402 instead of 372 to 394.
Changed
›
Stoneskin Totem
Rank 6: 30 yards instead of 20 yards, 5 min instead of 2 min, reworded.
Changed
›
Lightning Shield
Ranks 2 to 7 differ from Classic. Rank 7: 178 instead of 198.
Changed
›
Flametongue Weapon
Rank 6: 35 to 112 instead of 36.5 to 112.4, 60 minutes instead of 5 minutes.
Changed
›
Tremor Totem
5 min instead of 2 min.
Changed
›
Flame Shock
Ranks 1 to 5 differ from Classic. Rank 5: 254 instead of 245.
Changed
›
Strength of Earth Totem
Rank 5: 30 yards instead of 20 yards, 53 instead of 77, 5 min instead of 2 min, reworded.
Changed
›
Healing Stream Totem
Rank 5: 5 min instead of 1 min, 30 yards instead of 20 yards, 11 instead of 14.
Changed
›
Frostbrand Weapon
Rank 5: 169 instead of 187, 60 minutes instead of 5 minutes.
Changed
›
Lesser Healing Wave
Rank 6: 775 to 865 instead of 832 to 928.
Changed
›
Poison Cleansing Totem
30 yards instead of 20 yards, 5 min instead of 2 min.
Changed
›
Frost Shock
Rank 4: 495 to 524 instead of 492 to 520.
Changed
›
Frost Resistance Totem
Rank 3: 5 min instead of 2 min, 30 yards instead of 20 yards, reworded.
Changed
›
Mana Spring Totem
Rank 4: 5 min instead of 1 min, 30 yards instead of 20 yards.
Changed
›
Magma Totem
Rank 4: 73 instead of 75.

›
Fire Resistance Totem
Rank 3: 5 min instead of 2 min, 30 yards instead of 20 yards, reworded.
Changed
›
Disease Cleansing Totem
30 yards instead of 20 yards, 5 min instead of 2 min.

›
Flametongue Totem
Rank 4: 30 yards instead of 20 yards, 17 to 55 instead of 15.8 to 48.7, 5 min instead of 2 min, reworded.
Changed
›
Chain Heal
Rank 3: 474 to 539 instead of 567 to 646.
Changed
›
Chain Lightning
Rank 4: Costs 495 Mana instead of 605 Mana; 495 to 552 instead of 505 to 564.
Changed
›
Nature Resistance Totem
Rank 3: 5 min instead of 2 min, 30 yards instead of 20 yards, reworded.
Changed
›
Windfury Weapon
Rank 4: 60 minutes instead of 5 minutes.
Changed
›
Windfury Totem
Rank 3: Tooltip rewritten.
Changed
›
Windwall Totem
Rank 3: 30 yards instead of 20 yards, 5 min instead of 2 min.
Changed

Grace of Air Totem
Rank 3: 30 yards instead of 20 yards, 89 instead of 77, 5 min instead of 2 min, reworded.
